name: Pomizh khmar
source:
Close your eyes. Imagine that you are not here. That you are somewhere far away. In the reality you see in your dreams.  In the world you believed in when you were young. 

In the world of Fantasy. 

This is a metaphorical journey through a world of clouds, colorful ocean waters in the sky, and stars.

[translated from [url=https://hayivka.itch.io/clouds]itch.io[/url]]
